sources.topic: Language loading/removal, ARRAY reads, window writes, nested text, controls and static-variable format paths

contract.service: Explicit supplied ASCII text catalogs and per-language/name loaded snapshots; no native TX decoding or filesystem discovery
contract.syntax: Unique numbered/named elements, automatic numbering, comments, escapes, five-level acyclic nesting, bounded text/control/style tokens
contract.check: INTEGER IDs and STRING decimal/name compatibility forms; manual STRING versus historical accepted INTEGER compiler-case discrepancy retained
contract.formatting: Checked static scalar variable paths, explicit attached owners, fields/ARRAY/PATH nodes; bounded Python percent formatting, 32-bit unsigned conversions and argument reordering
contract.reads: One-based STRING ARRAY row ranges, untouched prefix/tail, last row, right truncation 33008 and complete-render preflight
contract.writes: Open logical window FILE only; complete request stages grid/cursor/position and one accepted WINDOW_WRITE event before commit
contract.languages: Exact current pendant or dictionary-model language, explicit default and remove-all behavior; no fallback or implicit packs
contract.limits: 64 source labels/loaded pairs, separate 1 MiB text budgets, 64 KiB per file, 4096 elements and 16384 expanded tokens/65536 output bytes
contract.persistence: Independent loaded/source text snapshots and language labels; parse on reload without ADD replay; window handles must close before context save

boundaries: No native binary TX files, UTX compiler, form definitions, glyph/color/style rendering or automatic language installation
Portable DP_DRAM/status values and Python numeric formatting; no native ABI, placement or restart-retention claim
No keyboard input, dynamic display controls, strict/controller acceptance
